name: usage-meter
description: Shows your claude.ai plan limits (session, weekly, Fable, extra usage) in a pane, read from the usage widget's usage_data.json

dataFile.title: usage_data.json path
dataFile.description: Absolute path to the usage_data.json that fetch_usage.py writes. Leave empty to look beside the mod's folder, then in ~/claude-usage-widget.
